name: 2027 AAN Annual Meeting
description: The AAN Annual Meeting is the flagship scientific and educational meeting of the American Academy of Neurology. The 2027 edition is held in Washington, D.C. and online, with plenary sessions, abstract presentations, and continuing medical education across neurology subspecialties.

deadlines.label: Abstract submission deadline
deadlines.note: 11:59 p.m. Central Time. A non-refundable submission fee applies and accepted abstracts must be presented in person.

deadlines.label: Abstract disclosure deadline
deadlines.note: 11:59 p.m. Central Time, required for submitted abstracts.

sources.note: Confirmed 2027 dates (May 1-5), Washington DC location, hybrid format, and that registration opens early November 2026.

notes: Registration deadlines and a specific Washington DC venue for 2027 are not yet published as of 2026-09-10; AAN states registration opens in early November 2026.
